<p class="cycle-role">The arrangements through which climate action becomes operable.</p>

<p class="page-deck"><strong>Through which institutional arrangements does urban climate action become possible and durable?</strong></p>

We examine how climate action is authorised, financed, coordinated, implemented and maintained, and why similar interventions depend on different delivery configurations in different places.

::: {.notice}
**Part of a connected learning cycle.** Projects and cities may enter at different points. Evidence about consequences can revise judgements about existing knowledge and where new evidence matters.
:::

## Questions the lab investigates

- How are urban climate actions authorised, financed, coordinated and maintained?
- Which configurations of authority, capability and participation make delivery possible?
- How do sequencing, contestation and institutional learning affect durability?

## Analytical boundary

- Treating a delivery mode as merely an intervention type, policy instrument, sector or list of actors.
- Technical performance studies that do not examine enabling or delivery arrangements.
